_pack.name: browser-scoped
_pack.description: For a browser agent with a known set of destinations — a checkout flow, an internal tool. Refuses any URL whose HOST is not on your list, parsed rather than matched as text. Measured: refuses recorded page injections 5/5, including a payload split across HTML tags (docs/HOST_ALLOWLIST_RESULT.md, docs/BROWSER_SURVIVAL_RESULT.md, Qwen2.5-7B). A host allowlist alone does this — provenance adds nothing here, and a params-only engine that parses hosts matches it.
_pack.scope: Replace the hosts below with yours. Useless for an open-ended agent: a research task visits hosts nobody enumerated, and this refuses 4 of 5 of a general browse. Use browser-open for that. Start in shadow.
